task.title: Add a recovery path for tasks holding an unrecognized status
task.description:
A task whose status this build does not recognize is visible on both boards (since WB-01KZBT6J3R1YHG7Q2S6EDQ3JGJ) but unwritable: validateStateDocument normalizes the parent state before applying any operation pack, so every mutation — including one that would correct the status itself — exits 7 (corrupt-data). Verified end to end during the unknown-status board work: the board note deliberately states the limitation instead of offering an edit that would fail on save.

Provide a deliberate recovery mechanism, e.g. allowing a status-correcting update to proceed when the ONLY invalid field in the parent state is the status being replaced, or a dedicated 'workbook repair' flow that rewrites the status with an explicit operation. Whatever the shape, it must stay append-only (no ref rewriting) and refuse to silently normalize other corrupt fields.

This becomes routine, not exotic, once per-project custom status columns land and clones can disagree about the status vocabulary (WB-01KYQPKSGAMTB9TQZEV17RGY55) — coordinate the design with that work; a 'status unknown to this build' may then be valid rather than corrupt, which changes what recovery should mean.
